summary_en: 50,000 shares (0.5% of S/O), ¥200M limit, ToSTNeT-3 at ¥4,000/share, execution 2026-08-21 08:45 JST, settlement same day. Stated rationale: capital efficiency and agile capital policy.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 20 August 2026, the board of Kanemi Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market, code 2669) authorised the acquisition of up to 50,000 treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on 21 August 2026. The shares will be purchased at ¥4,000 per share (the closing price on 20 August), for a total outlay not to exceed ¥200 million. This represents 0.5% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury denominator: 9,467,418 shares as of 28 February 2026). The company stated the rationale as improving capital efficiency and executing agile capital policy in response to changing business conditions. Results will be announced after trading closes at 08:45 JST on 21 August 2026.
